title: Affine effect absorption theorem
claim: For each fixed resource context R, every bounded affine probability functional on finite-dimensional quantum density matrices is Tr(E_R rho) for a unique quantum effect 0<=E_R<=I. Thus any affine resource-dependent probability deviation is operationally a changed effective effect, not a free-standing new probability rule.
novelty_boundary: Underlying convex/Riesz/effect representation mathematics is standard. Historical novelty is not claimed.
research_consequence: Target (3) must identify which physical or operational premise changes; a same-state same-effect affine correction is impossible.
